rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Your weapon of choice is a giant robot!?
rows.display_text:
「Your weapon of choice is a giant
robot!?」

rows.speaker: T-Bone
rows.en: Sorry to keep you waiting, boss!
rows.display_text: 「Sorry to keep you waiting, boss!」

rows.speaker: Dove
rows.en: I brought the Super Beck!
rows.display_text: 「I brought the Super Beck!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Alright, you two! Over here!!
rows.display_text: 「Alright, you two! Over here!!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Gwaaah! That's a dirty trick, beard-face!
rows.display_text:
「Gwaaah! That's a dirty trick,
beard-face!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Hahahahahaha! Bark all you want! I'll at least listen to your whining at the end!
rows.display_text:
「Hahahahahaha! Bark all you want! I'll at
least listen to your whining at the end!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Damn it all!
rows.display_text: 「Damn it all!」

rows.speaker: T-Bone
rows.en: Boss! He's making a run for it!
rows.display_text: 「Boss! He's making a run for it!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Nuhahaha, feels great! I can't get enough of this!
rows.display_text:
「Nuhahaha, feels great! I can't get
enough of this!」

rows.speaker: Dove
rows.en: Whoa! Boss! Watch the front, the front!!
rows.display_text:
「Whoa! Boss! Watch the front, the
front!!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Whaaat!?
rows.display_text: 「Whaaat!?」

rows.speaker: T-Bone
rows.en: A mobile suit!?
rows.display_text: 「A mobile suit!?」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: That meathead is the one piloting it!?
rows.display_text: 「That meathead is the one piloting it!?」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Sorry to keep you waiting, beard-face! I'll take you on with this!
rows.display_text:
「Sorry to keep you waiting, beard-face!
I'll take you on with this!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Don't underestimate me! Don't you dare look down on this Beck Victory Deluxe!
rows.display_text:
「Don't underestimate me! Don't you dare
look down on this Beck Victory Deluxe!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Wh-what!?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what!?」

rows.speaker: Dove
rows.en: Boss! This time look up, up!!
rows.display_text: 「Boss! This time look up, up!!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Aliens!? They're coming all the way out here!?
rows.display_text:
「Aliens!? They're coming all the way out
here!?」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: No questions asked, huh!? Damn, what a bunch of savages!
rows.display_text:
「No questions asked, huh!? Damn, what a
bunch of savages!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Gwoooah!!
rows.display_text: 「Gwoooah!!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Meathead!
rows.display_text: 「Meathead!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Dropping onto Earth without permission and doing whatever the hell you want!
rows.display_text:
「Dropping onto Earth without permission
and doing whatever the hell you want!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: If you go rampaging around, it'll cause trouble for Lady Dianna!
rows.display_text:
「If you go rampaging around, it'll cause
trouble for Lady Dianna!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: You...

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: If that's how you want it, then I, the great Corin Nander, will take you on!
rows.display_text:
「If that's how you want it, then I, the
great Corin Nander, will take you on!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Beard-face...
rows.display_text: 「Beard-face...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Picking a fight with aliens? You've got guts, I'll give you that.
rows.display_text:
「Picking a fight with aliens? You've got
guts, I'll give you that.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Temporary truce, meathead. I don't like those types who throw their weight around with numbers and power...
rows.display_text:
「Temporary truce, meathead. I don't like
those types who throw their weight
around with numbers and power...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Let's give them a taste of their own medicine together!
rows.display_text:
「Let's give them a taste of their own
medicine together!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Alright!
rows.display_text: 「Alright!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: I'm Corin Nander. Nice to work with you, partner!
rows.display_text:
「I'm Corin Nander. Nice to work with you,
partner!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: I'm Jason Beck. Let's make it flashy, Corin!
rows.display_text:
「I'm Jason Beck. Let's make it flashy,
Corin!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Look, Corin! The Federation finally showed up!
rows.display_text:
「Look, Corin! The Federation finally
showed up!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: They're too damn slow...! Geez!
rows.display_text: 「They're too damn slow...! Geez!」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: What the hell...! And here we went out of our way to sortie against the aliens as a special favor!
rows.display_text:
「What the hell...! And here we went out
of our way to sortie against the aliens
as a special favor!」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Doing whatever they please...! Who the hell are they!?
rows.display_text:
「Doing whatever they please...! Who the
hell are they!?」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: That mobile suit belongs to the Dianna Counter.
rows.display_text:
「That mobile suit belongs to the Dianna
Counter.」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: It's the type we saw at Fort Severn.
rows.display_text: 「It's the type we saw at Fort Severn.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: From what I can see, it's acting alone. Probably a deserter.
rows.display_text:
「From what I can see, it's acting alone.
Probably a deserter.」

rows.speaker: Geraba
rows.en: Boss! That flashy big guy over there!
rows.display_text: 「Boss! That flashy big guy over there!」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: No mistake! That's...
rows.display_text: 「No mistake! That's...」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: That giant machine over there...! Jason Beck!?
rows.display_text:
「That giant machine over there...! Jason
Beck!?」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Long time no see, boss Asuham. Small world, running into you out here.
rows.display_text:
「Long time no see, boss Asuham. Small
world, running into you out here.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: I remember now! He's the guy Asuham hired back in Katez!
rows.display_text:
「I remember now! He's the guy Asuham
hired back in Katez!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Can you hear me, acquaintance of Asuham's? This is the commander of this unit, Colonel Neo Roanoke.
rows.display_text:
「Can you hear me, acquaintance of
Asuham's? This is the commander of this
unit, Colonel Neo Roanoke.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: The situation is as you can see. I'm requesting your cooperation in intercepting the aliens.
rows.display_text:
「The situation is as you can see. I'm
requesting your cooperation in
intercepting the aliens.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: How much are you paying?
rows.display_text: 「How much are you paying?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Wh...what?
rows.display_text: 「Wh...what?」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: I'm talking business. I don't work for free.
rows.display_text:
「I'm talking business. I don't work for
free.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...Understood. I'll consider paying you on a performance basis.
rows.display_text:
「...Understood. I'll consider paying you
on a performance basis.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: You drive a hard bargain... ...well, fine. Consider it a deal for now.
rows.display_text:
「You drive a hard bargain... ...well, fine.
Consider it a deal for now.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Neo's got some strange taste. We'd be plenty without guys like them around.
rows.display_text:
「Neo's got some strange taste. We'd be
plenty without guys like them around.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Don't complain, Auel. Defending the city is our top priority.
rows.display_text:
「Don't complain, Auel. Defending the city
is our top priority.」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: Can you handle this, Four?
rows.display_text: 「Can you handle this, Four?」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Thank you, Rosamia. Sorry for worrying you.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Rosamia. Sorry for worrying
you.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: But I'm alright. Stella was kind to me.
rows.display_text: 「But I'm alright. Stella was kind to me.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Never thought I'd end up fighting alongside the legendary mobile suit, the Gundam. Kinda gives me a nice little thrill.
rows.display_text:
「Never thought I'd fight alongside the
legendary mobile suit, the Gundam. Kinda
gives me a nice little thrill.」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: You're wrong, Beck. That's not a Gundam.
rows.display_text:
「You're wrong, Beck. That's not a
Gundam.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: If it ain't white, it ain't a Gundam.
rows.display_text: 「If it ain't white, it ain't a Gundam.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Is that how it works...
rows.display_text: 「Is that how it works...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: All units, commence attack! Let's take down the alien forces!
rows.display_text:
「All units, commence attack! Let's take
down the alien forces!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Get pumped, Corin! With money on the line, I'm going all out for real!
rows.display_text:
「Get pumped, Corin! With money on the
line, I'm going all out for real!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: You bet! I won't let them trash the place Lady Dianna's coming home to!
rows.display_text:
「You bet! I won't let them trash the
place Lady Dianna's coming home to!」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Confirmed the annihilation of the alien forces.
rows.display_text:
「Confirmed the annihilation of the alien
forces.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Heh... with the great Beck lending a hand, this much is a piece of cake.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... with the great Beck lending a
hand, this much is a piece of cake.」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Same goes for the great Corin Nander.
rows.display_text: 「Same goes for the great Corin Nander.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Thanks to you, we were able to protect the city. I'm grateful.
rows.display_text:
「Thanks to you, we were able to protect
the city. I'm grateful.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: I don't need thanks. Ten thousand in cash beats a thousand words.
rows.display_text:
「I don't need thanks. Ten thousand in
cash beats a thousand words.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: What a couple of self-satisfied jerks. We didn't need help from guys like that anyway.
rows.display_text:
「What a couple of self-satisfied jerks.
We didn't need help from guys like that
anyway.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: That's enough, Auel. Before you worry about petty pride, recognize what you're supposed to be doing.
rows.display_text:
「That's enough, Auel. Before you worry
about petty pride, recognize what you're
supposed to be doing.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Look at the city. If we'd been dragging our feet, that parent and child over there would have lost their lives.
rows.display_text:
「Look at the city. If we'd been dragging
our feet, that parent and child over
there would have lost their lives.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Parent and child?
rows.display_text: 「Parent and child?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: This is bad...!
rows.display_text: 「This is bad...!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: That's right. That's a mother and her daughter, I'd say.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. That's a mother and her
daughter, I'd say.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Mother... Mom...?
rows.display_text: 「Mother... Mom...?」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Mom...! Moooom!! Aaaaaaaah!!
rows.display_text: 「Mom...! Moooom!! Aaaaaaaah!!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Him...! Use the Block Word!
rows.display_text: 「Him...! Use the Block Word!」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Mom...! Moooom!!
rows.display_text: 「Mom...! Moooom!!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: What's going on...!? What happened to Auel!?
rows.display_text:
「What's going on...!? What happened to
Auel!?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Sting, Stella...! Restrain Auel! We're heading back!
rows.display_text:
「Sting, Stella...! Restrain Auel! We're
heading back!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Hold up, chief! What about our pay!?
rows.display_text: 「Hold up, chief! What about our pay!?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Something troublesome has come up. I'll make sure you're paid, so come along with us.
rows.display_text:
「Something troublesome has come up. I'll
make sure you're paid, so come along with
us.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Can't be helped... I can't stand getting stiffed on a payment.
rows.display_text:
「Can't be helped... I can't stand getting
stiffed on a payment.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Auel...
rows.display_text: 「Auel...」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: What happened to him...
rows.display_text: 「What happened to him...」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: Four...
rows.display_text: 「Four...」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: They're the same as us, aren't they...
rows.display_text: 「They're the same as us, aren't they...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: First the Shadow Angels, then the Hyakki Empire, and now it's aliens.
rows.display_text:
「First the Shadow Angels, then the
Hyakki Empire, and now it's aliens.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Still, this is war...! I never expected to get to choose my enemies!
rows.display_text:
「Still, this is war...! I never expected
to get to choose my enemies!」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: What a drag. They could've just left this to some garrison unit around here.
rows.display_text:
「What a drag. They could've just left
this to some garrison unit around here.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Then go ahead and slack off. Just know Major Bran's special training will be waiting for you afterward.
rows.display_text:
「Then go ahead and slack off. Just know
Major Bran's special training will be
waiting for you afterward.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: No way! I'll show that guy what we can really do in actual combat!
rows.display_text:
「No way! I'll show that guy what we can
really do in actual combat!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Whatever the enemy is, all I can do is fight...!
rows.display_text:
「Whatever the enemy is, all I can do is
fight...!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I won't let myself get taken down in a place like this...! I'm going to rise to the top!!
rows.display_text:
「I won't let myself get taken down in a
place like this...! I'm going to rise to the
top!!」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: (I have to do this...)
rows.display_text: （(I have to do this...)）

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: (The Newtype Institute says that if I rack up combat results, they'll give me back my lost memories...)
rows.display_text:
（(The Newtype Institute says that if I
rack up combat results, they'll give me
back my lost memories...)）

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: (I want my memories back... proof that I'm alive. I'll do anything for that...!)
rows.display_text:
（(I want my memories back... proof that
I'm alive. I'll do anything for that...!)）

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: Aliens... those who come from space... those who come from above to torment me...
rows.display_text:
「Aliens... those who come from space...
those who come from above to torment
me...」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: Space, falling down on me...! Vanish, source of my nightmares!
rows.display_text:
「Space, falling down on me...! Vanish,
source of my nightmares!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: I can't let the Cyber-Newtypes have their way on this battlefield...!
rows.display_text:
「I can't let the Cyber-Newtypes have
their way on this battlefield...!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: For that reason too, we need to show our superiors what we can do on our own!
rows.display_text:
「For that reason too, we need to show
our superiors what we can do on our own!」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: You demons attacking this city...! Know that this planet has a man like me on it!
rows.display_text:
「You demons attacking this city...! Know
that this planet has a man like me on it!」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Here I come! As long as I'm here, I won't allow any more violence!!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come! As long as I'm here, I
won't allow any more violence!!」

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: So as long as we're in this unit, we're gonna end up fighting guys like that too, huh...!
rows.display_text:
「So as long as we're in this unit, we're
gonna end up fighting guys like that too,
huh...!」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: We've come this far, so steel yourself! Let your guard down and it's seriously bad news!
rows.display_text:
「We've come this far, so steel yourself!
Let your guard down and it's seriously
bad news!」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: (They could just let $c handle guys like this...)
rows.display_text:
（(They could just let $c handle guys
like this...)）

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: (We have no choice but to follow orders. To hide our true purpose, we'll play the part of obedient soldiers for now.)
rows.display_text:
（(We have no choice but to follow
orders. To hide our true purpose, we'll
act the obedient soldier for now.)）

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Let's go, Schlan! We'll protect the city from the aliens!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, Schlan! We'll protect the city
from the aliens!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: What's wrong, Schlan?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Schlan?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: No... don't worry about it. Let's focus on the enemy in front of us.
rows.display_text:
「No... don't worry about it. Let's focus
on the enemy in front of us.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Roger that!
rows.display_text: 「Roger that!」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: (You're prepared to lay down your life for General Edel's ideals...)
rows.display_text:
（(You're prepared to lay down your life
for General Edel's ideals...)）

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: (Lowen... that purity of yours is a sweet poison to me...)
rows.display_text:
（(Lowen... that purity of yours is a
sweet poison to me...)）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: What's wrong, Anemone...!? You need to focus!
rows.display_text:
「What's wrong, Anemone...!? You need to
focus!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Shut up! You can just keep quiet and watch!
rows.display_text:
「Shut up! You can just keep quiet and
watch!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Anemone...
rows.display_text: 「Anemone...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: (Could contact with the Cyber-Newtype be destabilizing Anemone's mind...!?)
rows.display_text:
（(Could contact with the Cyber-Newtype
be destabilizing Anemone's mind...!?)）

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Get a grip, Anemone! You've got an enemy you have to fight, don't you!?
rows.display_text:
「Get a grip, Anemone! You've got an
enemy you have to fight, don't you!?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Cynthia...
rows.display_text: 「Cynthia...」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Then fight! If it ends here, everything will have been for nothing!
rows.display_text:
「Then fight! If it ends here, everything
will have been for nothing!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Ah...

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: I know that without you telling me!
rows.display_text: 「I know that without you telling me!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Anemone...!
rows.display_text: 「Anemone...!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: That does it...! I'll scatter these guys in no time flat!
rows.display_text:
「That does it...! I'll scatter these guys
in no time flat!」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: Whoaaa! I won't let these guys who barged onto our planet do as they please!
rows.display_text:
「Whoaaa! I won't let these guys who
barged onto our planet do as they please!」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: (Droopy-eyes is a simple guy. Playing the soldier all the way now, huh.)
rows.display_text:
（(Droopy-eyes is a simple guy. Playing
the soldier all the way now, huh.)）

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: (I've got no intention of risking my life in a place like this. I'll just go through the motions.)
rows.display_text:
（(I've got no intention of risking my
life in a place like this. I'll just go
through the motions.)）

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: From here on it's performance-based business! Let's go all in! You ready, Corin!?
rows.display_text:
「From here on it's performance-based
business! Let's go all in! You ready,
Corin!?」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: You bet! Time to cut loose for the first time in a while today!
rows.display_text:
「You bet! Time to cut loose for the
first time in a while today!」

rows.speaker: T-Bone
rows.en: (Just a moment ago they were on the verge of blows, and now they're totally hitting it off...!)
rows.display_text:
（(Just a moment ago they were on the
verge of blows, and now they're totally
hitting it off...!)）

rows.speaker: Dove
rows.en: (That's a duo you never want as your enemy.)
rows.display_text:
（(That's a duo you never want as your
enemy.)）

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Get ready, aliens! The strongest tag team's about to take you on!
rows.display_text:
「Get ready, aliens! The strongest tag
team's about to take you on!」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: This is unbelievable...
rows.display_text: 「This is unbelievable...」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Never mind the yellow and green mobile armor over here...
rows.display_text:
「Never mind the yellow and green mobile
armor over here...」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: A giant transforming Gundam, huh... It's way beyond anything I imagined.
rows.display_text:
「A giant transforming Gundam, huh... It's
way beyond anything I imagined.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Its name is the Psycho Gundam. Apparently it's a state-of-the-art machine.
rows.display_text:
「Its name is the Psycho Gundam.
Apparently it's a state-of-the-art
machine.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: You two... you're members of Special Task Force 013, aren't you.
rows.display_text:
「You two... you're members of Special
Task Force 013, aren't you.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Yeah, we are. Who are you guys?
rows.display_text: 「Yeah, we are. Who are you guys?」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: I'm Major Bran Blutarch, assigned to Special Task Force 013 as of today. I'm also the pilot of this Asshimar.
rows.display_text:
「I'm Major Bran Blutarch, assigned to
Special Task Force 013 as of today. I'm
also the pilot of this Asshimar.」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: I'm Ensign Rosamia Badam.
rows.display_text: 「I'm Ensign Rosamia Badam.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: The pilot of that black one?
rows.display_text: 「The pilot of that black one?」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: No... my mobile suit is the Gaplant.
rows.display_text: 「No... my mobile suit is the Gaplant.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: (I saw it in the files. So she's the Augusta test subject... the so-called Cyber-Newtype.)
rows.display_text:
（(I saw it in the files. So she's the
Augusta test subject... the so-called
Cyber-Newtype.)）

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Then who's piloting that thing?
rows.display_text: 「Then who's piloting that thing?」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: The Psycho Gundam's pilot is Ensign Four Murasame.
rows.display_text:
「The Psycho Gundam's pilot is Ensign
Four Murasame.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: The Ensign has stepped away due to feeling unwell. Sorry, but save your introductions for later.
rows.display_text:
「The Ensign has stepped away due to
feeling unwell. Sorry, but save your
introductions for later.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Can someone that frail actually pull their weight in a special task force?
rows.display_text:
「Can someone that frail actually pull
their weight in a special task force?」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Let me say this before you go prying any further, Auel Neider.
rows.display_text:
「Let me say this before you go prying
any further, Auel Neider.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Ensign Rosamia Badam and Ensign Four Murasame are soldiers who require Adjustment.
rows.display_text:
「Ensign Rosamia Badam and Ensign Four
Murasame are soldiers who require
Adjustment.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Huh...!

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: You mean...
rows.display_text: 「You mean...」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: That's right. The same kind of soldier as you two.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. The same kind of soldier
as you two.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: (Sting Oakley and the others are Extended... people whose combat abilities were enhanced through surgery and drug administration.)
rows.display_text:
（(Sting Oakley and the others are
Extended... people whose combat abilities
were enhanced by surgery and drugs.)）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: (No matter the world or the goal, humans do the same things everywhere, huh...)
rows.display_text:
（(No matter the world or the goal,
humans do the same things everywhere,
huh...)）

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: So what about it...!? You got a problem!?
rows.display_text:
「So what about it...!? You got a
problem!?」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: No.
rows.display_text: 「No.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Huh...

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: But that's only if you two carry out your duties as soldiers.
rows.display_text:
「But that's only if you two carry out
your duties as soldiers.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: The Commander asked me to oversee your combat training. Come to the simulation room.
rows.display_text:
「The Commander asked me to oversee
your combat training. Come to the
simulation room.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Hold on...! Special training all of a sudden!?
rows.display_text:
「Hold on...! Special training all of a
sudden!?」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Don't argue. If you're a member of the special task force, prove it to me with your skill.
rows.display_text:
「Don't argue. If you're a member of the
special task force, prove it to me with
your skill.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Tch! Don't wet yourselves once you see what we can do!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! Don't wet yourselves once you see
what we can do!」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: (My head... it hurts...)
rows.display_text: （(My head... it hurts...)）

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: (Again... it's time for the Psycho's adjustment... I don't want it... I don't want to get in that thing...)
rows.display_text:
（(Again... it's time for the Psycho's
adjustment... I don't want it... I don't
want to get in that thing...)）

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: (But if I don't get in it and fight... my memories won't come back...)
rows.display_text:
（(But if I don't get in it and fight...
my memories won't come back...)）

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: What... who are you...?
rows.display_text: 「What... who are you...?」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Does it hurt?
rows.display_text: 「Does it hurt?」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Huh...

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Does your stomach hurt? Does your head hurt?
rows.display_text:
「Does your stomach hurt? Does your
head hurt?」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: ...You... are you a member of Special Task Force 013?
rows.display_text:
「...You... are you a member of Special
Task Force 013?」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Stella... Stella Loussier.
rows.display_text: 「Stella... Stella Loussier.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: I'm Ensign Four Murasame. ...Sorry, but leave me alone for now. I have a headache.
rows.display_text:
「I'm Ensign Four Murasame. ...Sorry, but
leave me alone for now. I have a
headache.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Wh-what are you doing...!? Don't touch me!
rows.display_text:
「Wh-what are you doing...!? Don't touch
me!」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: It's good to put your hand where it hurts. Neo taught me that.
rows.display_text:
「It's good to put your hand where it
hurts. Neo taught me that.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Neo...? You mean Commander Neo Roanoke...
rows.display_text:
「Neo...? You mean Commander Neo
Roanoke...」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Not just Neo. Sting and Auel did it too.
rows.display_text: 「Not just Neo. Sting and Auel did it too.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: How is it?
rows.display_text: 「How is it?」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: It's cool... it feels nice...
rows.display_text: 「It's cool... it feels nice...」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Thank you... I feel a little better now.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you... I feel a little better now.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Hmm... so that's the girl who's newly come to the special task force.
rows.display_text:
「Hmm... so that's the girl who's newly
come to the special task force.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: What's wrong?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: I just realized... that girl... she's the same as me...
rows.display_text:
「I just realized... that girl... she's the
same as me...」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Anemone...
rows.display_text: 「Anemone...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: That girl's head must hurt too, until she can't do anything about herself anymore...
rows.display_text:
「That girl's head must hurt too, until
she can't do anything about herself
anymore...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: But she fights... she has to fight...
rows.display_text: 「But she fights... she has to fight...」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: ...I know you're using strong drugs to keep your headaches down...
rows.display_text:
「...I know you're using strong drugs to
keep your headaches down...」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Why do you fight, even doing something like that?
rows.display_text:
「Why do you fight, even doing something
like that?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: There's an enemy I have to defeat... For Dewey's sake, I have to fight...
rows.display_text:
「There's an enemy I have to defeat...
For Dewey's sake, I have to fight...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: If I don't, then I... I...
rows.display_text: 「If I don't, then I... I...」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: I see...
rows.display_text: 「I see...」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: ...I get it, that feeling...
rows.display_text: 「...I get it, that feeling...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: I don't want to hear you acting like you understand!
rows.display_text:
「I don't want to hear you acting like
you understand!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: ...That's not it...
rows.display_text: 「...That's not it...」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: That Dewey person of yours... he's probably like Master Kizz is to me...
rows.display_text:
「That Dewey person of yours... he's
probably like Master Kizz is to me...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: You...

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: This alarm... what was it again?
rows.display_text: 「This alarm... what was it again?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: This is... a scramble alert! Let's get to the hangar!
rows.display_text:
「This is... a scramble alert! Let's get to
the hangar!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Where are you looking, pal? Slamming your shoulder into me outta nowhere.
rows.display_text:
「Where are you looking, pal? Slamming
your shoulder into me outta nowhere.」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Ahn? That's my line. Want me to yank that beard right off?
rows.display_text:
「Ahn? That's my line. Want me to yank
that beard right off?」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: If you'd just apologized honestly, I would've settled for a little compensation... You're not too bright, pal.
rows.display_text:
「If you'd just apologized honestly, I
would've settled for a little
compensation... You're not too bright, pal.」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: I don't get what you're saying. Spell it out simpler.
rows.display_text:
「I don't get what you're saying. Spell it
out simpler.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Looks like even your brain's made of muscle, you!
rows.display_text:
「Looks like even your brain's made of
muscle, you!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: So basically you wanna go at it with me? ...The sun's about to set. Let's settle this quick.
rows.display_text:
「So basically you wanna go at it with
me? ...The sun's about to set. Let's
settle this quick.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: I'm the brains type, see. I wouldn't do something as stupid as trade bare fists with a meathead like you.
rows.display_text:
「I'm the brains type, see. I wouldn't do
something as stupid as trade bare fists
with a meathead like you.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: So, with that said, I'll be using my weapon of choice!
rows.display_text:
「So, with that said, I'll be using my
weapon of choice!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Block Word...?
rows.display_text: 「Block Word...?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: That's right. It functions as a safety measure to suppress an Extended's berserk state.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. It functions as a safety
measure to suppress an Extended's berserk
state.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Hearing that word makes them lose their mental balance, and depending on the case, renders them unable to fight.
rows.display_text:
「Hearing that word makes them lose their
mental balance, and depending on the case,
renders them unable to fight.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: The fact that something like that is necessary means...
rows.display_text:
「The fact that something like that is
necessary means...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: It's just as you suspect, Major. In the past, the Extended training facility was wiped out by a revolt of the child test subjects.
rows.display_text:
「As you suspect, Major. The Extended
training facility was once wiped out in a
revolt by the child test subjects.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Auel and the others are from that same facility.
rows.display_text:
「Auel and the others are from that same
facility.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: ...Forced to fight for someone else's convenience, and if they try to resist, they're robbed of their freedom of mind...
rows.display_text:
「...Forced to fight for someone else's
convenience, and if they try to resist,
they're robbed of their freedom of mind...」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: It's an unbearable story, sir.
rows.display_text: 「It's an unbearable story, sir.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...I think so too.
rows.display_text: 「...I think so too.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Including Ensign Rosamia and Ensign Four, I don't look favorably on the existence of enhanced soldiers.
rows.display_text:
「Including Ensign Rosamia and Ensign
Four, I don't look favorably on the
existence of enhanced soldiers.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Major...
rows.display_text: 「Major...」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: But I also think it's meaningless to hold them individually responsible for it.
rows.display_text:
「But I also think it's meaningless to
hold them individually responsible for it.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: And as soldiers, once they stand on the front line, that doesn't change the fact that they are soldiers.
rows.display_text:
「And as soldiers, once they stand on
the front line, that doesn't change the
fact that they are soldiers.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: That's why I have no intention of treating them as anything special.
rows.display_text:
「That's why I have no intention of
treating them as anything special.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: I'll simply carry out my duties alongside them, both as their superior and as a comrade.
rows.display_text:
「I'll simply carry out my duties
alongside them, both as their superior and
as a comrade.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Thank you, Major. Those words are enough.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Major. Those words are
enough.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: If anyone has doubts about what happened today, please explain it to them yourself, Major.
rows.display_text:
「If anyone has doubts about what
happened today, please explain it to them
yourself, Major.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Understood.
rows.display_text: 「Understood.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: ...By the way, what about that bearded man and the Dianna Counter deserter?
rows.display_text:
「...By the way, what about that bearded
man and the Dianna Counter deserter?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I've left their contract to Staff Officer Dominic and Asuham.
rows.display_text:
「I've left their contract to Staff
Officer Dominic and Asuham.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I intend to fold them into the special task force as combat strength as well.
rows.display_text:
「I intend to fold them into the special
task force as combat strength as well.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Even if it's as our superiors wished, this is getting more chaotic by the day.
rows.display_text:
「Even if it's as our superiors wished,
this is getting more chaotic by the day.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Chaos, huh... Who'd have thought this unit would end up like a microcosm of the multiverse.
rows.display_text:
「Chaos, huh... Who'd have thought this
unit would end up like a microcosm of the
multiverse.」

rows.en: Excuse me, Colonel Neo Roanoke. Supplies have arrived from Federation HQ, sir.
rows.display_text:
「Excuse me, Colonel Neo Roanoke. Supplies
have arrived from Federation HQ, sir.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I've heard about it. Arrange for the supplies to be forwarded to the Izumo.
rows.display_text:
「I've heard about it. Arrange for the
supplies to be forwarded to the Izumo.」

rows.speaker: Federation Soldier
rows.en: Actually, about that, sir -- a strange person seems to have slipped in along with the supplies...
rows.display_text:
「Actually, about that, sir -- a strange
person seems to have slipped in along
with the supplies...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: A strange person...?
rows.display_text: 「A strange person...?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Everyone, fall in, nya~!!
rows.display_text: 「Everyone, fall in, nya~!!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: What's with this old geezer... where'd he sneak in from?
rows.display_text:
「What's with this old geezer... where'd
he sneak in from?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Nuhuhu... I'm one who dwells in the darkness of men... I'm everywhere, and I show up anywhere, nya.
rows.display_text:
「Nuhuhu... I'm one who dwells in the
darkness of men... I'm everywhere, and I
show up anywhere, nya.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Alright, alright. Mouar, show him to the exit.
rows.display_text:
「Alright, alright. Mouar, show him to the
exit.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Understood. ...Please follow me, then.
rows.display_text: 「Understood. ...Please follow me, then.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: If following you, miss, leads to heaven, that'd be great, but I've got things to do, nya.
rows.display_text:
「If following you, miss, leads to heaven,
that'd be great, but I've got things to
do, nya.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: What a stubborn old man. Fine, I'll toss you out myself.
rows.display_text:
「What a stubborn old man. Fine, I'll toss
you out myself.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Tossing me out alone's no good, nya! Bring beer too!
rows.display_text:
「Tossing me out alone's no good, nya!
Bring beer too!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Hey, old man... that's enough...
rows.display_text: 「Hey, old man... that's enough...」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Treat me that coldly and I won't give you the new model, nya.
rows.display_text:
「Treat me that coldly and I won't give
you the new model, nya.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: What...?
rows.display_text: 「What...?」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Dr. Jie, you were here...!?
rows.display_text: 「Dr. Jie, you were here...!?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Yo, Lowen, Schlan! Enjoying yourselves, nya?
rows.display_text:
「Yo, Lowen, Schlan! Enjoying yourselves,
nya?」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: You know him, Captain?
rows.display_text: 「You know him, Captain?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: This is Dr. Jie Baibell. He's the technical officer assigned exclusively to the Chimera.
rows.display_text:
「This is Dr. Jie Baibell. He's the
technical officer assigned exclusively to
the Chimera.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Nice ta meetcha, baby!
rows.display_text: 「Nice ta meetcha, baby!」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: This bizarre old geezer is a technical officer...!?
rows.display_text:
「This bizarre old geezer is a technical
officer...!?」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: So you came here along with the supply shipment, then.
rows.display_text:
「So you came here along with the supply
shipment, then.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Old man... you said something about a new model earlier, right?
rows.display_text:
「Old man... you said something about a
new model earlier, right?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: You bet, nya! I brought new model units for you all to test out!
rows.display_text:
「You bet, nya! I brought new model units
for you all to test out!」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Here... this is the list of units I brought, nya.
rows.display_text:
「Here... this is the list of units I
brought, nya.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: The Baund Doc and the Byarlant... they're already finished...!?
rows.display_text:
「The Baund Doc and the Byarlant...
they're already finished...!?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: They're strictly test units, nya. I'll leave the shakedown to you, nya.
rows.display_text:
「They're strictly test units, nya. I'll
leave the shakedown to you, nya.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: And it's not just mobile suits I brought, nya.
rows.display_text:
「And it's not just mobile suits I
brought, nya.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Overman Golem, Mexbrute, the Silhouette Machine Dobeck, and even a top-of-the-line Walker Machine.
rows.display_text:
「Overman Golem, Mexbrute, the Silhouette
Machine Dobeck, and even a
top-of-the-line Walker Machine.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: This is fantastic! This'll boost our combat strength in one go!
rows.display_text:
「This is fantastic! This'll boost our
combat strength in one go!」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: However, Doctor... I find it hard to believe someone of your standing would come to the field for a mere supply run...
rows.display_text:
「However, Doctor... I find it hard to
believe someone of your standing would
come to the field for a mere supply run...」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: As expected of you, Schlan! Sharp as ever!
rows.display_text:
「As expected of you, Schlan! Sharp as
ever!」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Truth is... I've been entrusted with an important set of orders, nya.
rows.display_text:
「Truth is... I've been entrusted with an
important set of orders, nya.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: (That face of his... doesn't look like it's carrying anything serious...)
rows.display_text:
（(That face of his... doesn't look like
it's carrying anything serious...)）

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: So that's how it is, nyan. Miss... take me to see your commander, nyan.
rows.display_text:
「So that's how it is, nyan. Miss... take
me to see your commander, nyan.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: That's...
rows.display_text: 「That's...」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I'll show the doctor there myself. Mouar, please check over the new units.
rows.display_text:
「I'll show the doctor there myself.
Mouar, please check over the new units.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Aww~! A knight had to go and butt in...
rows.display_text:
「Aww~! A knight had to go and butt
in...」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Sorry about that, Doctor. Can't have you putting an important comrade of mine in danger.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry about that, Doctor. Can't have
you putting an important comrade of mine
in danger.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Uhyo! Am I a danger boy!?
rows.display_text: 「Uhyo! Am I a danger boy!?」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Come on, let's go, Doctor. I'm not exactly free either.
rows.display_text:
「Come on, let's go, Doctor. I'm not
exactly free either.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Ah... quit grabbing me by the collar! This is a forced arrest, nya!
rows.display_text:
「Ah... quit grabbing me by the collar!
This is a forced arrest, nya!」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: So it's a situation serious enough for Dr. Jie to come in person...
rows.display_text:
「So it's a situation serious enough for
Dr. Jie to come in person...」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Something's definitely about to happen...
rows.display_text: 「Something's definitely about to happen...」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: How are you feeling, Four?
rows.display_text: 「How are you feeling, Four?」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Not bad. Even after actual combat, I feel clear-headed. Barely any headache either.
rows.display_text:
「Not bad. Even after actual combat, I
feel clear-headed. Barely any headache
either.」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: Maybe that treatment from the girl named Stella worked.
rows.display_text:
「Maybe that treatment from the girl
named Stella worked.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Maybe.
rows.display_text: 「Maybe.」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: Speak of the devil... here she comes.
rows.display_text: 「Speak of the devil... here she comes.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Stella, did you come to see the bazaar too?
rows.display_text:
「Stella, did you come to see the bazaar
too?」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: If you'd like, want to look around together? I'd also like to properly introduce you to Rosamia.
rows.display_text:
「If you'd like, want to look around
together? I'd also like to properly
introduce you to Rosamia.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: ...Sting and Auel are waiting for me over there.
rows.display_text:
「...Sting and Auel are waiting for me
over there.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Stella...
rows.display_text: 「Stella...」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: She's an odd one... even though back at the base, she was the one who approached Four first.
rows.display_text:
「She's an odd one... even though back at
the base, she was the one who approached
Four first.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Stella, and that Auel kid and the others too... they're the same as us, aren't they.
rows.display_text:
「Stella, and that Auel kid and the
others too... they're the same as us,
aren't they.」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: I want to... get closer to her.
rows.display_text: 「I want to... get closer to her.」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: True enough. If we can't communicate like this, coordinated tactics will be difficult.
rows.display_text:
「True enough. If we can't communicate
like this, coordinated tactics will be
difficult.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: No... that's not what I mean. I want to be her friend.
rows.display_text:
「No... that's not what I mean. I want to
be her friend.」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: A friend... huh...
rows.display_text: 「A friend... huh...」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」
